name: Google Address Autocomplete
description: Adds Google Places address autocomplete to survey and data entry forms. As the participant types, predictions are offered and the selected address is split into the mapped fields (street number, street, city, state, postcode, country, coordinates). Several independent address field sets can be configured — for example the participant's home address on one instrument and their GP practice address on another. Optionally recovers unit/apartment numbers that Google omits for Australian and UK addresses. Requires a Google Maps API key with the Places API (New) enabled, and an https connection.

project-settings.name:
Google API Key
One key is used for every address field set on this project.

Import Google API
Emits the Google Maps bootstrap loader. Disable only if another module on this project already loads the Google Maps API. The loader is emitted at most once per page regardless of how many address field sets are configured.

Privacy notice shown under the address box
What the participant types is sent to Google to generate the suggestions, so it must be disclosed to them. A short default notice is shown automatically; enter your own wording here to replace it. The same notice is shown under every address field set.

Hide the privacy notice
Suppresses the notice entirely. Tick this only if your participant information / consent form already discloses that addresses are sent to Google. Sending personal information to Google is a disclosure to a third party, and for Australian projects an overseas disclosure under APP 8.

Address field sets
Each set is one address search box and the fields it populates. Add a set for each address the project captures — for example the participant's home address and their GP practice address. Put each set on its own instrument and name that instrument below: two search boxes on one page work, but they compete for the participant's attention and each one asks for location access separately.

sub_settings.name:
Name / description
Optional. For your own reference only, and shown in the browser console to identify this set when debugging.

Disable this address field set
Keeps the field mapping but stops the search box appearing.

Instrument(s) this set applies to
Leave blank to apply to any form that contains the Autocomplete Field below. Naming the instrument means nothing at all is emitted on other pages.

Autocomplete Field (text only)
The field the search box attaches to. It is hidden on the form and receives the full formatted address.

County Field
Leave blank for Australian projects: the council area would overwrite the suburb.

Place Name Field
The name of the selected place, e.g. the medical centre's name.

Recover unit/apartment number from typed text
Google often omits the subpremise component for Australian unit addresses, so 3/27 Harris St is returned as street number 27 and the unit is lost. When enabled, the unit is parsed from what the user typed and prepended to the Street Number Field as 3/27.
Requires Street Number Field to be mapped, and that field must have no integer/number validation.

Restrict predictions to region codes
Optional comma-separated CLDR region codes, e.g. au (maximum 15). Leave blank for no restriction.

Restrict predictions to place types
Optional comma-separated Google place types from Place Type tables A and B, e.g. street_address,premise,subpremise (maximum 5). Leave blank for no restriction. Verify in the browser console that predictions still appear after setting this.
